description: Mark an item sold when no reservation currently holds it — a walk-up sale, an item sold elsewhere, or one whose reservation already expired or was cancelled. Changes the item status to "taken". Check get_listings first: if the item's status is "available", this is the right tool. If it is "reserved", a buyer is holding it and this tool refuses — nothing is saved. For a reserved item that the buyer actually collected, use confirm_pickup: it closes the reservation, releases the pickup slot, and emails the buyer. Do not use confirm_pickup to record a sale to someone else — it tells the reserving buyer they collected it. If the buyer collected only part of what they reserved, neither tool applies — tell the seller to confirm the collected items from that reservation in their ClearList inbox.
